description: This test case validates the Google OAuth login functionality to ensure users can authenticate and access the Roost dashboard.
steps: Locate the Google login button using the stable selector.
Click on the Google login button.
Verify redirection back to the Roost dashboard.
Ensure the user's name is displayed on the dashboard, confirming successful login.
expected_results: User is redirected to the Google authentication page.
User is successfully authenticated using valid credentials.
User is redirected to the Roost dashboard with access to their account.
edge_cases: The Google login service is temporarily unavailable.
The user cancels the authentication process midway.
Google account is locked or restricted.
data_requirements: Test environment configured to allow Google OAuth login.
Google OAuth client ID and redirect URI setup correctly.
A user account linked with Roost.
dependencies: Google OAuth service must be operational.
Roost application must support OAuth redirection.
User account must exist in the Roost system.
api_interactions: Google OAuth API for token exchange.
Roost backend API for user authentication and session creation.
performance_metrics: Response time for Google OAuth redirection.
Loading time for the Roost dashboard post-login.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Google login button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify screen reader announces the purpose of the Google login button.
Ensure adequate color contrast for the Google login button.
